title: Questionnaire Q32-33 illustrations: pointing-arm elevation arc and street-scene sky dome
description: Illustrated questionnaire page (printed page 284). Question 32 shows a quarter-circle arc over a skyline of houses and trees, with a man at the corner whose arm is drawn pointing at many successive elevations, for marking the object's height when first ("A") and last ("B") seen. Question 33 shows a large dome-shaped drawing of a tree-lined suburban street with a figure standing in the road, seen from behind, plus a smaller example sketch in which a dashed path runs from "A" to "B" across the sky.
